x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
min_diff_value = 2e9
ratio_value = x / y
best_numerator = 0
best_denominator = 1

for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    a = int(ratio_value * i + 0.4999)
    current_diff = abs((a / i) - ratio_value)
    if current_diff < min_diff_value:
        min_diff_value = current_diff
        best_numerator = a
        best_denominator = i

print(f"{best_numerator}/{int(best_denominator)}")
